citations.quote: My daughter (5) has had three colds since then, the last one turned into bronchitis, and her paediatrician says sleeping in a cold room is a clear factor.
I don't know whether it is mould or damp, or something else entirely.
Every night since the end of August something switches the boiler off; by the morning the thermometer in the bedrooms shows 15 to 16 degrees.
An independent heating expert has to examine the system to find out what is wrong; I have asked Wohnwerk to arrange that.
I have decided that I will pay my rent into the official deposit account until the heating is repaired.
Landlord: Wohnwerk Thur GmbH, Toggenburgerstrasse 120, 9500 Wil

plan.because: The supplied lease identifies the parties and some terms but does not identify the rented property. Request the complete contract.
Obtain the defect report to establish what was reported and when.
Establish whether and when the landlord received the defect report.
Document the visible condition, affected location and observation dates.
Obtain the landlord's responses, proposed work and access arrangements.
The mould branch is unresolved; clarify the dark spots before requesting this conditional evidence.
Heating failure is reported; obtain the dated inspection and service findings.
Health effects are reported; obtain documented findings and any limits on attributed cause.
An independent heating inspection is reported as needed. Obtain any report available; the cause remains open.
The customer is considering official rent deposit; obtain any written repair deadline and its contents.
This evidence is optional under the process.

questions: Is the child currently safe and receiving appropriate medical care, and is there an immediate heating or health risk requiring urgent assistance?
Have the dark spots been identified as mould, damp or something else?
When and how were the heating fault and ceiling spots reported to the landlord, and is proof of receipt available?
Has a written repair deadline been communicated to the landlord, and has any independent inspection been arranged or completed?
